cues: From these come the formulas: time of flight two u sin theta over g, greatest height u squared sin squared theta over two g, and range u squared sin two theta over g. Sin two theta is largest at forty five degrees.
And theta and ninety minus theta have the same sin two theta: that is why fifteen and seventy five degrees landed together.
